mode_notes.study: Runs baseline premise checks, bounded primitive qualification, then eligible comparisons. Reuses qualified expert checkpoints within that run.
mode_notes.qualify: Stops after qualification. Available for a prerequisite-only pilot; a later study does not automatically import an earlier qualification directory.
mode_notes.prepare: CPU corpus construction, oracle execution and leakage audit only.

method_choice.name: Agent-Dice paper-equation implementation on dense effective LoRA deltas
method_choice.critical_difference: coordinate-wise majority follows paper and Llama script, not Qwen script tensor-wide any() selection
method_choice.control: arithmetic mean of identical expert deltas with identical dense storage
method_choice.capacity_boundary: independent specialist fusion stores four expert factor pairs plus dense projection offsets; neither fusion is labeled fixed-memory sequential LoRA8

main_comparisons: relevant vs equal-budget irrelevant history, with fresh reference
continued learning vs 64-total-example replay, replacing two of four exposures without increasing update count
Agent-Dice vs arithmetic fusion of the same four qualified specialists

checkpoint_format.effective_delta: offset + (config.lora_alpha/config.rank) * B @ A; treat None offset as zero
checkpoint_format.fusion_payload: B is exactly zero, A is original shared random initialization, offset holds the complete uncompressed fused update
checkpoint_format.forward: base_linear(x) + float32 effective-delta application cast to base output dtype; offsets stay separate from frozen bfloat16 base weights
checkpoint_format.dense_rank: shape and theoretical rank upper bound recorded per projection. No claim that numerical rank has been measured.
checkpoint_format.checked_loader: learning.load_model(config) requires one visible ROCm GPU, verifies the pinned snapshot file hashes, loads BF16 base weights and installs FP32 adapters. learning.load_checkpoint(model, checkpoint_directory) validates checkpoint tensor/optimizer manifests and finite FP32 factors/offsets, restores them, and returns the saved optimizer state or None.
checkpoint_format.behavior_reconstruction: Build spec/corpus with data.build_corpus(config); encoded=learning.load_tokenizer(config,spec["conventions"]); call learning.generate(model,encoded,rows) and learning.score(records).
checkpoint_format.separate_process_behavioral_reload: not implemented as a standalone CLI; the exposed loader/generation functions support a parent-owned fresh-process audit
checkpoint_format.load_metadata: runtime.json load_proof records requested base dtype, actual parameter/buffer dtype counts, ROCm/GPU identity, model-placement guard and every checked snapshot file hash.

direction_gates.saturated_raw_baseline: stop before training; preserve predictions and design a new ambiguity-controlled binding experiment on train/dev only
direction_gates.primitive_acquisition_failure: bounded shared 128/256/512 update ladder; save training-fit/format/EOS/execution diagnostics, and perform zero transfer/fusion/stream work
direction_gates.stream_new_family_failure: stop only that arm before next task or workflow training; retain other qualified directions
direction_gates.fusion_or_composition_failure: retain full outcome and continue remaining predefined controls; do not search hyperparameters using TEST
direction_gates.next_parent_owned_experiment: conditionally compress a qualified fused effective update by SVD, re-evaluate generated behavior, then consider teacher or PorTAL bridge; none implemented here

limits: synthetic in-memory tool execution, not external service use
argument schemas can reveal operation roles, so measured baselines and irrelevant-history controls are necessary
requests state operations and order: composition of known calls, not autonomous subgoal discovery
varied data, mappings, family orders and targets with one optimization seed; not an optimization-seed sweep
fusion expert-training and state budgets differ from fixed-rank sequential learning and are reported separately

numerical_path.native_fp32_base_components: allowed; all parameter and buffer dtype counts recorded
numerical_path.device: cuda:0 within exactly one visible ROCm GPU
numerical_path.finiteness: check all floating parameters/buffers after loading; validate checkpoint factors/offsets before restore and adapter parameters after every optimizer update
numerical_path.qualification: Archived followthrough-20260912-qualify-qwen35-4b source explicitly loaded BF16. This lane preserves that requested dtype. The qualification does not establish behavior of this custom learner.
numerical_path.placement_proof: Actual parameter/buffer placement plus absence of Accelerate hooks; optional hf_device_map validated when present

snapshot_identity.expected_content_binding: All ten existing cached-file digests independently cross-checked against Hub revision 851bf6e806efd8d0a36b00ddf55e13ccb7b8cd0a using LFS SHA256 for large files and fetched git-blob-checked small files.
snapshot_identity.runtime: Verify size and streamed SHA256 for all required files before model loading; separately verify tokenizer inputs before tokenizer loading. Reject unknown entries except named nonloading documents and .cache metadata. Check file identity remained unchanged during hash/load.
snapshot_identity.boundary: Expected file hashes are verified against the exact Hub revision now; the loader will hash the actual GPU-side cached bytes at dispatch. No remote cache or provider action performed by this lane.

startup_guard_correction.reported_failure: MODEL_OFFLOAD before baseline; old guard incorrectly required optional hf_device_map metadata

source_diagnosis.finding: from_pretrained calls accelerate_dispatch only for multiple distinct devices or disk; single-device loading bypasses the code that sets hf_device_map
source_diagnosis.reproduction: CPU tiny Qwen3.5 save_pretrained/from_pretrained with explicit root device_map and BF16 produces no hf_device_map and no Accelerate hooks; all parameters and buffers reside on CPU
source_diagnosis.boundary: CPU reproduction verifies SDK metadata behavior, not the GPU placement of the failed parent attempt; old exception did not capture actual map/tensor devices

guard.primary_evidence: Every named parameter and buffer must physically reside on the assigned device; attached Accelerate _hf_hook objects are forbidden at root or nested modules
guard.optional_metadata: Absent, None or empty hf_device_map is accepted; a present map must have the expected mapping type and only assigned-device entries
guard.diagnostics: MODEL_PLACEMENT_AUDIT and all guard failures include expected device, actual tensor device counts, hf_device_map presence/type/repr and hook module/type/repr; successful load_proof retains the same record
guard.unchanged_checks: one visible ROCm GPU; BF16 base, FP32 adapters/offsets, finite tensors, no autocast/TF32, pinned snapshot file hashes
